app "Lifts" dumbbell ink
table lift name pick Squat|Bench|Deadlift|Press|Row = Squat, kg num 0..400, reps num 1..30 = 5, rpe num? 1..10

    each options lift.name as n

  section "Sets per lift", "this month"
    share lift month by name, count(it), it.key
  "Days trained this month" count(days month, count(lift on it) > 0) faint
  list lift by day

request: give the last service line a section called summary
program_before:
app "Car service" car slate
table car name text, plate text?, km num 0.., oil_gap num 1000..20000 = 5000 unit "km"
table service car ref car, work pick Oil|Tyres|Brakes|Battery|Wash|Other = Oil, at_km num 0.., cost money, note text?
let spent_year = sum(service.cost year)
topbar service, "Log service"
statcard spent_year, "spent on cars this year"
"Last service" since(service) "days ago" faint
section "Cars"
  each car sort name as c empty "Add your first car."
    stack card gap 1 tap edit c swipe remove c
      row gap 2
        c.name bold grow
        c.plate faint
      "Odometer" c.km "km" faint
      if c.km - max(last(c.service where work = Oil).at_km, 0) >= c.oil_gap
        "Oil change is due" bold color bad
      else
        "Oil is fine for" c.oil_gap - (c.km - max(last(c.service where work = Oil).at_km, 0)) "km" faint
section "Spending by work", "this year"
  share service year by work, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Each car", "this year"
  each car as c
    row gap 2
      c.name grow
      sum(c.service.cost year) bold
section "Recent work"
  each service top 6 as s
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.car.name bold
        s.work s.at_km "km" faint
      s.cost bold
form car, "Add car"
remind "Check the oil and tyres" monthly on 1 at 9:00

request: a ramadan planner for the family: daily fasts kept, tarawih, pages of quran read per person, and sehri and iftar notes
program:
app "Ramadan" moon plum
table person name text
table day_log person ref person, fasted bool, tarawih bool, pages num 0..60 = 0, note text?
setting target_pages num 1..60 = 20 "Pages a day goal"
state who ref person
let done_pages = sum(day_log.pages today)
topbar person, "Add person"
choice who
"Today" head
row gap 2
  statcard count(day_log today where fasted = yes), "fasting today"
  statcard count(day_log today where tarawih = yes), "prayed tarawih"
goal done_pages, target_pages * count(person), "pages read by the family today", "pages"
section "Log for", "pick a person above"
  toggle day_log today where person = who and fasted = yes
  toggle day_log today where person = who and tarawih = yes
  row gap 2
    "Pages today" grow
    button "+1" tap add day_log person = who, pages = 1
    button "+5" tap add day_log person = who, pages = 5
section "Pages per person", "this month"
  each person sort name as p
    row gap 2
      p.name grow
      sum(p.day_log.pages month) bold
section "Fasts kept", "this month"
  each person sort name as p
    row gap 2
      p.name grow
      count(p.day_log month where fasted = yes) "of 30" faint
section "Family pages per day"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(day_log.pages on it)
section "Notes"
  each day_log where note != "" as d
    row card gap 2 swipe remove d
      d.person.name bold
      d.note grow
form day_log, "Add a note"

  each member sort turn as m
    row gap 2 swipe remove m
      m.turn faint
      m.name grow

section "Deposits by month"
  bars [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], sum(deposit.amount month of addmonths(today, it - 6))
form member, "Add member"

connect to my car and read the mileage by bluetooth
Question: Molde apps cannot connect to a car. Do you want a quick button on each car to add 100 km to its odometer, so you can keep it up to date?
Answer: Yes, add a plus 100 km button
program_before:
app "Car service" car slate
table car name text, plate text?, km num 0.., oil_gap num 1000..20000 = 5000 unit "km"
table service car ref car, work pick Oil|Tyres|Brakes|Battery|Wash|Other = Oil, at_km num 0.., cost money, note text?
let spent_year = sum(service.cost year)
topbar service, "Log service"
statcard spent_year, "spent on cars this year"
"Last service" since(service) "days ago" faint
section "Cars"
  each car sort name as c empty "Add your first car."
    stack card gap 1 tap edit c swipe remove c
      row gap 2
        c.name bold grow
        c.plate faint
      "Odometer" c.km "km" faint
      if c.km - max(last(c.service where work = Oil).at_km, 0) >= c.oil_gap
        "Oil change is due" bold color bad
      else
        "Oil is fine for" c.oil_gap - (c.km - max(last(c.service where work = Oil).at_km, 0)) "km" faint
section "Spending by work", "this year"
  share service year by work, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Each car", "this year"
  each car as c
    row gap 2
      c.name grow
      sum(c.service.cost year) bold
section "Recent work"
  each service top 6 as s
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.car.name bold
        s.work s.at_km "km" faint
      s.cost bold
form car, "Add car"
remind "Check the oil and tyres" monthly on 1 at 9:00

table order customer ref customer, dress pick Shalwar|Kameez|Suit|Waistcoat|Coat = Suit, due date, price money, advance money = 0, ready bool, picked bool
let owed = sum(order where picked = no, it.price - it.advance)
topbar order, "New order"
statcard owed, "to collect from customers"
"Orders open" count(order where picked = no) bold
row gap 2
  stat count(order where picked = no and due < today), "late"
  stat count(order where ready = yes and picked = no), "ready"
  stat count(order where due = today), "due today"
section "Ready for pickup"
  each order where ready = yes and picked = no sort due as o empty "Nothing waiting."
    row card gap 2
      stack grow gap 0
        o.customer.name bold
        o.dress "balance" o.price - o.advance faint
      button "Handed over" tap set o.picked = yes
section "In progress"
  each order where ready = no sort due as o
    row card gap 2 tap edit o swipe remove o
      toggle o.ready
      stack grow gap 0
        o.customer.name bold
        o.dress "due" o.due faint
      if(o.due < today, "Late", "") color bad
section "Dresses made", "this month"
  each options order.dress as d
    row gap 1
      d grow
      count(order month where dress = d) bold
section "Customers"
  each customer sort name as c
    row gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
      c.name grow
      c.chest c.waist c.length faint
form customer, "Add customer"

app "Committee" users orange
setting share money = 5000 "Monthly share"
table member name text, turn num 1..60, phone text?
table deposit member ref member, amount money
let pot = count(member) * share
topbar deposit, "Record deposit"
statcard sum(deposit.amount month), "collected this month", pot
"This month's pot" pot big
each member sort turn as m
  if m.turn = (month(today) % count(member)) + 1
    row card gap 2 fill soft
      icon trophy
      m.name bold grow
      "gets the pot this month" faint
section "Paid", "this month"
  each member where sum(deposit.amount month) >= share sort name as m empty "Nobody has paid yet."
    row gap 2
      icon check
      m.name grow
      sum(m.deposit.amount month) faint
section "Late"
  each member where sum(deposit.amount month) < share sort name as m
    row card gap 2 tap edit m
      m.name bold grow
      share - sum(m.deposit.amount month) bold color bad
      button "Got it" tap add deposit member = m, amount = share - sum(m.deposit.amount month)
section "Order of turns"
  each member sort turn as m
    row gap 2 swipe remove m
      m.turn faint
      m.name grow
      m.phone faint
section "Deposits by month"
  bars [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], sum(deposit.amount month of addmonths(today, it - 6))
form member, "Add member"
list deposit by day

program:
app "Tailor" pen plum
table customer name text, chest num? 20..60, waist num? 20..60, length num? 20..60
table order customer ref customer, dress pick Shalwar|Kameez|Suit|Waistcoat|Coat = Suit, due date, price money, advance money = 0, ready bool, picked bool
let owed = sum(order where picked = no, it.price - it.advance)

statcard owed, "to collect from customers"

        o.customer.name bold
        o.dress "balance" o.price - o.advance faint
      button "Handed over" tap set o.picked = yes
section "In progress"
  each order where ready = no sort due as o
    row card gap 2 tap edit o swipe remove o
      toggle o.ready
      stack grow gap 0
        o.customer.name bold
        o.dress "due" o.due faint
      if(o.due < today, "Late", "") color bad
section "Dresses made", "this month"
  each options order.dress as d
    row gap 1
      d grow
      count(order month where dress = d) bold
section "Customers"
  each customer sort name as c
    row gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c

      c.chest c.waist c.length faint
form customer, "Add customer"

app "Tailor" pen plum
table customer name text, chest num? 20..60, waist num? 20..60, length num? 20..60
table order customer ref customer, dress pick Shalwar|Kameez|Suit|Waistcoat|Coat = Suit, due date, price money, advance money = 0, ready bool, picked bool
let owed = sum(order where picked = no, it.price - it.advance)
topbar order, "New order"
statcard owed, "to collect from customers"
"Orders open" count(order where picked = no) bold
row gap 2
  stat count(order where picked = no and due < today), "late"
  stat count(order where ready = yes and picked = no), "ready"
  stat count(order where due = today), "due today"
section "Ready for pickup"
  each order where ready = yes and picked = no sort due as o empty "Nothing waiting."
    row card gap 2
      stack grow gap 0
        o.customer.name bold
        o.dress "balance" o.price - o.advance faint
      button "Handed over" tap set o.picked = yes
section "In progress"
  each order where ready = no sort due as o
    row card gap 2 tap edit o swipe remove o
      toggle o.ready
      stack grow gap 0
        o.customer.name bold
        o.dress "due" o.due faint
      if(o.due < today, "Late", "") color bad
section "Dresses made", "this month"
  each options order.dress as d
    row gap 1
      d grow
      count(order month where dress = d) bold
section "Customers"
  each customer sort name as c
    row gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
      c.name grow
      c.chest c.waist c.length faint
form customer, "Add customer"

program:
app "Bakery" bread pink
table item name text, price money, kind pick Bread|Cake|Cookies = Bread
table sale item ref item, qty num 1..100 = 1, paid bool
setting target money = 20000 "Daily target"

section "Items"
  each item sort name as i

      i.name bold grow
      i.price faint
      i.kind faint
form item, "Add item"

table service car ref car, work pick Oil|Tyres|Brakes|Battery|Wash|Other = Oil, at_km num 0.., cost money, note text?
let spent_year = sum(service.cost year)
topbar service, "Log service"
statcard spent_year, "spent on cars this year"
"Last service" since(service) "days ago" faint
section "Cars"
  each car sort name as c empty "Add your first car."
    stack card gap 1 tap edit c swipe remove c
      row gap 2
        c.name bold grow
        c.plate faint
      "Odometer" c.km "km" faint
      if c.km - max(last(c.service where work = Oil).at_km, 0) >= c.oil_gap
        "Oil change is due" bold color bad
      else
        "Oil is fine for" c.oil_gap - (c.km - max(last(c.service where work = Oil).at_km, 0)) "km" faint

  share service year by work, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Each car", "this year"
  each car as c
    row gap 2
      c.name grow
      sum(c.service.cost year) bold
section "Recent work"
  each service top 6 as s
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.car.name bold
        s.work s.at_km "km" faint
      s.cost bold
form car, "Add car"
remind "Check the oil and tyres" monthly on 1 at 9:00

table person name text

      count(p.day_log month where fasted = yes) "of 30" faint

  daybars last 14 days, sum(day_log.pages on it)

let spent_year = sum(service.cost year)
topbar service, "Log service"
statcard spent_year, "spent on cars this year"
"Last service" since(service) "days ago" faint
section "Cars"
  each car sort name as c empty "Add your first car."
    stack card gap 1 tap edit c swipe remove c
      row gap 2
        c.name bold grow
        c.plate faint
      "Odometer" c.km "km" faint
      if c.km - max(last(c.service where work = Oil).at_km, 0) >= c.oil_gap
        "Oil change is due" bold color bad
      else
        "Oil is fine for" c.oil_gap - (c.km - max(last(c.service where work = Oil).at_km, 0)) "km" faint
section "Spending by work", "this year"
  share service year by work, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Each car", "this year"
  each car as c
    row gap 2
      c.name grow
      sum(c.service.cost year) bold
section "Recent work"
  each service top 6 as s
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.car.name bold
        s.work s.at_km "km" faint
      s.cost bold
form car, "Add car"
remind "Check the oil and tyres" monthly on 1 at 9:00
